address: 34 Longxia Road, Ouhai, Wenzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: This unassuming shop has won the hearts of local gourmets with its signature noodle soup topped with brown croaker bone or brown croaker head. Both are deep-fried until crispy and cooked with garlic, onion and carrot into a rich dense broth. Other toppings include seafood, offal and meat. Spiced soy-braised pork cheek boasts springy skin and tender meat. They also excel at turning brown croaker scraps and trimmings into tasty snacks.
